summary: D1-backed page rendering is COMMITTED AND INERT: wired behind PAGES_FROM_D1, off by default, set nowhere (not wrangler.jsonc, not a committed .dev.vars, not a prod secret). Nothing deployed, nothing pushed. The file render remains the live path and is also the fallback on flag-off, no row, empty html, draft, has_components, non-route, or a throwing lookup - an unreachable D1 cannot 500 a page. IMPORTANT: this render path is NOT byte-faithful. The D1 path emits & where the file path emits &; both display as '&' so nothing is visually broken, but the output is functionally equivalent rather than identical. 4 of 16 candidate routes are eligible today (/arts/write-life, /learning, /privacy, /terms); the other 12 fall back because PAGES_CDN_BASE is unset and their ./ relative images resolve to hashed /_astro/ URLs at build, with those 26 sibling images 404 on the CDN - rewriting them would ship broken images. Markdown is pre-rendered at ingest into site_pages.html so the Worker carries no markdown library: 0.75 MB gzipped vs a 0.74 MB baseline (bundling Astro's processor pulled in shiki at 2.88 MB, and it landed even with the flag off, so it would not have been inert).
